rdfs:label: issuanceDate
rdfs:comment: The date-time at which a VerifiableCredential was issued — the credential is not considered valid before this instant.
notes: VC 1.1 term (required there). VC Data Model 2.0 replaces it with `validFrom` (https://www.w3.org/2018/credentials#validFrom), which is optional; the v2 context does not define `issuanceDate`. Use it when reading or writing VC 1.1 credentials — plenty of VC 1.1 data still exists — and prefer `validFrom` for new VC 2.0 credentials. Distinct from `dcterms:created` / `dcterms:issued`, which VC verifiers do not consult.

history.note: Notes corrected: required only in VC 1.1; VC 2.0 uses optional validFrom; removed self-contradictory 'same semantics' claim. Added validFrom to seeAlso.
